guide.summary: The cathedral, city museums, the zoo and cable car, with Kölsch brewhouses, fine dining, cafés and a hotel bar checked against their own websites.
guide.tip: Sightseeing inside Cologne Cathedral has required a ticket since 1 July 2026, while the north transept entrance stays free for prayer.

toolkit.label: Closing days
toolkit.copy: MAKK, Museum Schnütgen, the Rautenstrauch-Joest-Museum, the Käthe Kollwitz Museum and the Museum für Ostasiatische Kunst close on Mondays. Kolumba closes on Tuesdays instead, and Café Konditorei Wahlen is shut on Mondays.

toolkit.label: Tickets
toolkit.copy: Cologne Cathedral sells sightseeing tickets online and the Schokoladenmuseum suggests buying in its webshop to skip the box-office wait. Kölner Zoo day tickets bought online are cheaper and include VRS public transport.

toolkit.label: Walk-in or booking
toolkit.copy: The Kölner Seilbahn sells tickets only at the counter and takes no reservations. Päffgen takes table reservations only by phone from 12:00, and taku strongly recommends booking early.

toolkit.label: Guided entry
toolkit.copy: The Farina Fragrance Museum can only be seen on a guided tour, offered in English, German, Chinese and French, and online booking is recommended.

guide.dek: Start with the cathedral and the museums around it, and book Altstadt dinners and timed tours before you arrive.
intro: Cologne Cathedral is the obvious place to start, but plan for the change made on 1 July 2026: sightseeing inside is now ticketed. You can see the interior daily from about 10:00 to 17:45, with shorter afternoon hours on Sundays and church holidays, and the north transept entrance stays free for prayer. The tower is open from 09:00, until 16:00 from November to February. Museum Ludwig is next door and keeps late hours until 22:00 on the first Thursday of each month.

This winter Museum Ludwig opens two new shows: Lee Ufan, winner of the Wolfgang-Hahn-Preis 2026, from 7 November to 4 April 2027, and Man Ray's Kiki in the photography rooms from 31 October to 13 June 2027. Kolumba's annual exhibition on norm and deviation runs until 1 August 2027, daily from 12:00 to 17:00 except Tuesdays. MAKK shows Hans Georg Esch's architectural photography until 17 January 2027, and the Museum für Ostasiatische Kunst has temporarily lowered its admission to €7.50.

The Römisch-Germanisches Museum's building on Roncalliplatz is closed for renovation, so you'll find its collection in the Belgisches Haus on Cäcilienstraße, a short walk from the Rautenstrauch-Joest-Museum and Museum Schnütgen. The Wallraf-Richartz-Museum is closed until the end of 2028. With children, Kölner Zoo is open every day of the year, and its China Lights run from 11 December to 31 January. The Schokoladenmuseum opens daily from 10:00 to 18:00.

For food, Kölsch brewhouses fill the Altstadt. Brauhaus Sion opens daily from noon, Gaffel am Dom serves breakfast from 10:00 to 11:30, and Päffgen on Friesenstraße takes bookings only by phone. For a special evening, taku and the Hanse Stube are both in the Excelsior Hotel Ernst, where the Charles Bar opens daily from noon. Ox & Klee serves dinner Wednesday to Saturday. Café Reichard by the cathedral opens daily from 8:30 and lays out a breakfast buffet at weekends.
summaryCards: Buy your Cologne Cathedral sightseeing ticket online, then cross to Museum Ludwig and finish with a Kölsch at Früh am Dom or Brauhaus Sion.
Café Reichard opens at 8:30 every day and serves a breakfast buffet on Saturdays, Sundays and holidays until 11:30.
Many city museums close on Mondays and Kolumba on Tuesdays, while Päffgen takes table bookings only by phone from noon.

limitations: Website review, not a visit or telephone confirmation. Advertised opening, booking and exhibition details do not guarantee availability. Museum Ludwig, the Römisch-Germanisches Museum interim site, Früh am Dom and the NS-Dokumentationszentrum did not publish full weekly hours on the pages read; taku's hours were stated only for its October 2026 anniversary menu, and the Hanse Stube's only for goose season (30 Oct-23 Dec 2026). Peters Brauhaus, Päffgen, Café Reichard and Café Konditorei Wahlen showed no 2026-dated item beyond hours, menus or copyright lines. The Kölner Seilbahn goes into winter break after 8 November apart from Advent weekends. KölnTriangle, Odysseum, Little Link, Suderman, Van Dyck, Heilandt, Hallmackenreuther and Monkey Bar Köln could not be read (connection, DNS, TLS, 403 or 429 errors), Le Moissonnier's address and ERNST Kaffeeröster's house numbers were not readable, and City of Cologne pages for the Flora and the weekly markets returned HTTP 410, so no market, park or dedicated coffee roaster is included.
